question: What is the primary purpose of a cryptographic hash function in integrity checking?
options: A) To recover the original plaintext

question: What is a common sign that a model is overfitting?
options: A) It performs poorly on training and test data equally
B) It performs very well on training data but poorly on unseen data
C) It has no trainable parameters
D) Its training set contains labels
reference_answer: B) It performs very well on training data but poorly on unseen data
